description: Design a production-grade RESTful Task Management API engine with schema validation, CRUD controllers, token authentication, role-based access control (RBAC), and structured exception handling.
problemStatement: Enterprise engineering teams require a secure task management backend where authenticated users can create, query, and update tasks, while destructive operations (such as deleting tasks or purging records) are strictly restricted to `admin` roles with full schema validation and audit status codes.
realWorldScenario: You are architecting the core request dispatcher, model schema validator, and RBAC security middleware for a multi-tenant Task Management API.
objectives: Design task database models with strict priority (`low`, `medium`, `high`) and status (`todo`, `in_progress`, `done`) constraints.
Implement CRUD operations (create, list/filter, update status, delete).

title: Java OOP Banking Engine
description: Develop an enterprise banking domain model in Java applying abstract classes, Savings & Checking account polymorphism, overdraft protection, and atomic inter-account transfer rollback.
problemStatement: Core banking ledgers must guarantee that deposits, withdrawals, interest accruals, and inter-account transfers preserve strict monetary invariants. Savings accounts accrue interest and forbid negative balances, while Checking accounts support a configurable overdraft limit.
realWorldScenario: You are implementing the core domain ledger engine for a digital banking microservice in Java, processing batch ledger commands and outputting deterministic account state snapshots.
objectives: Create an abstract `Account` base class encapsulating account ID, holder name, and balance.
Implement `SavingsAccount` (with interest accrual and zero-overdraft rule) and `CheckingAccount` (with overdraft protection limit).
Implement atomic `transfer(fromId, toId, amount)` in `BankEngine` that rolls back if debit or credit fails.
Validate negative transaction amounts and insufficient funds deterministically.

ioSpecification.inputFormat: Single-line command string on stdin: DEPOSIT, WITHDRAW, TRANSFER, INTEREST, or INVALID_TEST

functionalRequirements.description: Allow withdrawals up to balance + overdraftLimit.

functionalRequirements.title: Atomic Inter-Account Transfer
functionalRequirements.description: Execute debit and credit atomically; leave both balances unchanged if debit fails.

functionalRequirements.title: Negative Amount & Missing Account Guards
functionalRequirements.description: Reject <= 0 amounts and invalid account IDs cleanly.

technicalRequirements.constraint: Use @Override on polymorphic withdraw methods.

technicalRequirements.title: Integer Cent / Exact Formatting
technicalRequirements.constraint: Format balances consistently as whole numbers for deterministic ledger assertions.

technicalRequirements.title: Graceful Error Reporting
technicalRequirements.constraint: Output structured error codes (INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS, INVALID_AMOUNT) without uncaught exceptions.

solutionFiles.content:
import sys
import json
from question_bank import get_public_questions, add_question
from grading_engine import grade_submission

def main():
    raw = sys.stdin.read().strip()
    if not raw:
        print(json.dumps({"ok": False, "error": "EMPTY_INPUT"}))
        return
    req = json.loads(raw)
    action = req.get("action", "")
    payload = req.get("payload", {})

    if action == "fetch_exam":
        qs = get_public_questions()
        print(json.dumps({"ok": True, "count": len(qs), "questions": qs}))
    elif action == "submit_exam":
        res = grade_submission(
            payload.get("answers", {}),
            payload.get("timeTakenSec", 0),
            payload.get("timeLimitSec", 600)
        )
        print(json.dumps(res))
    elif action == "add_question":
        print(json.dumps(add_question(payload)))
    else:
        print(json.dumps({"ok": False, "error": "UNKNOWN_ACTION"}))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

solutionFiles.content:
import sys
import json
from vector_store import ingest_document
from rag_pipeline import answer_question

def main():
    raw = sys.stdin.read().strip()
    if not raw:
        print(json.dumps({"ok": False, "error": "EMPTY_INPUT"}))
        return
    req = json.loads(raw)
    action = req.get("action", "")
    payload = req.get("payload", {})

    if action == "query":
        print(json.dumps(answer_question(payload.get("question", ""))))
    elif action == "ingest":
        print(json.dumps(ingest_document(
            payload.get("id", ""),
            payload.get("title", ""),
            payload.get("text", "")
        )))
    else:
        print(json.dumps({"ok": False, "error": "UNKNOWN_ACTION"}))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
